# TillSwift: London POS Installation, Software Engineering & Payment Advice

> Dedicated London Point of Sale (POS) and till engineering consultancy led
> by Neville Bryce (ex-City algorithmic trading software engineer). On-site
> Greater London installation for SumUp, Square, Stripe Terminal, Clover,
> Lightspeed, and Shopify POS, custom software integrations, resilient
> venue networking, and impartial 3-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
> payment provider comparison.

## Executive Summary

TillSwift (https://tillswift.com/) is an engineer-led one-stop consultancy
covering every aspect of modern till and payment systems in London. Unlike
traditional till fitters who only configure basic vendor menus—or card sales
representatives tied to long-term leases—TillSwift combines hands-on counter
hardware and networking skills with full production software engineering and
thorough business requirements gathering.

## Primary Services

- **On-Site London POS Installation:** Turnkey setup of SumUp (13-inch
  Countertop Register, POS Lite, Solo), Square (Register, Stand, Terminal),
  Stripe Terminal (Reader S700, S710, BBPOS WisePOS E), Clover, Lightspeed,
  and Shopify POS—including hardware already purchased directly by the shop
  or restaurant.
- **Bespoke POS Software & Complex Requirements:** In-depth requirements
  discovery, custom Stripe Terminal Software Development Kit (SDK)
  checkouts, Square and Shopify Application Programming Interface (API)
  bridges, inventory sync, and automated Xero/QuickBooks/Sage journals.
- **Resilient Shop & Kitchen Networking:** Dedicated Ethernet runs, static
  Local Area Network (LAN) printer reservations (Star Micronics, Epson),
  Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) payment isolation, and 4G/5G failover.
- **Impartial Payment Provider Advice & 3-Year TCO Calculator:** Mathematical
  fee auditing across SumUp, Square, Stripe, Revolut Business, Teya, and
  Interchange-Plus (IC+) acquirers at https://tillswift.com/compare.html.

## How We Work

1. **Initial Requirements Conversation:** Free initial phone call or deeper
   scoping chat to map your real operational workflow without jargon.
2. **Written Statement of Work & Fixed Quote:** A clear engineering plan with
   an up-front fixed price or transparent £50 per hour rate.
3. **Calm, Long-Term Advisory:** No aggressive follow-up sales chasing;
   pre-build off-site, swift London cutovers (including out-of-hours), and
   ongoing software/hardware support whenever needed.

## Also Known As: Search Terms and Synonyms

People search for Point of Sale (POS) and till engineering in many ways:

- Till = checkout = cash register = Electronic Cash Register (ECR) = EPOS =
  ePOS = POS = point of sale = counter terminal = takings machine.
- SumUp installer = SumUp Solo = SumUp 13-inch Countertop Touchscreen
  Register = SumUp POS Lite = SumUp Air = SumUp setup London.
- Square installer = Square Register = Square Stand = Square Terminal =
  Square Reader = Square Kitchen Display System (KDS) = Square POS setup
  London.
- Stripe Terminal installer = Stripe Reader S700 = Stripe Reader S710 =
  BBPOS WisePOS E = WisePad 3 = Stripe Terminal Software Development Kit
  (SDK) integration London.
- Till fitter = POS installer = EPOS engineer = software support engineer =
  custom POS developer = API integration = Xero or QuickBooks sync = shop
  Wi-Fi and Ethernet cabling.
